fichas.title: Golf Courses
fichas.summary: Overview of golf course elements, practice facilities, course lengths, green construction and modelling, bunker design, and practice-area layouts. A golf centre may fit on 10 ha and include a practice area, approach green, practice green, and a 9-hole par-3 course. Course siting is described in relation to terrain and natural landscape features.
uses: Playing golf courses of varying hole counts and lengths
